aboutP1: Dziko ili likuonetsa mipingo ya Katolika, machapeli, malo oyera, mabasilika ndi makatedrale {n}. Zimachokera ku {a1}zambiri za malo za Overture Maps{end} (mtundu {release}), zomwe zimasonkhanitsa malo kuchokera ku Meta, Microsoft ndi magwero ena otseguka.
aboutP2: Mwa izi, malo {cat} alembedwa mu Overture ngati malo opembedzera a Roma Katolika. Ena {name} alembedwa ngati malo opembedzera a Chikhristu okha, ndipo aphatikizidwa chifukwa mayina awo akuonetsa bwino kuti ndi a Katolika (mwachitsanzo “Parroquia”, “Paróquia”, “Basilica”, “Nossa Senhora”). Tsatanetsatane wawo ali ndi chidziwitso.
aboutP3: Palibe zambiri zotseguka zomwe zili ndi maparishi onse. Zambiri ndi zochuluka ku Amereka ndi Kumadzulo kwa Ulaya, ndipo ndi zochepa m'madera ena a Afirika ndi Asia, kumene maparishi ambiri sanafike pa mapu. Zina zikhoza kukhala zobwerezedwa, maofesi, kapena nyumba zotsekedwa. Mukatsegula mpingo, tsambali limasaka chithunzi chake pa {a1}Wikimedia Commons{end} ndi Wikipedia malinga ndi malo ndi dzina, ndipo limatchula wojambulayo. Mipingo yopanda chithunzi imaonetsa chojambula. Khadi lililonse lili ndi maulalo a zithunzi, makanema ndi Street View zina.

about_seasonAdvent: Advent ndi masabata anayi Khrisimasi isanafike, pamene Mpingo ukukonzekera ndi chiyembekezo chachimwemwe kubwera kwa Khristu: kukumbukira kubadwa kwake ku Betelehemu ndi kudikira kubweranso kwake mu ulemerero. Mtundu wake ndi wofiirira, ndi pinki pa Lamlungu la Gaudete.
about_seasonChristmas: Nyengo ya Khrisimasi imakondwerera kubadwa kwa Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu, kuyambira Khrisimasi, kudutsa pa Epifania, mpaka Ubatizo wa Ambuye. Mtundu wake ndi woyera, chizindikiro cha chimwemwe ndi ulemerero.
about_seasonOrdinary: Nyengo Wamba ndi gawo la chaka kunja kwa Advent, Khrisimasi, Lenti ndi Pasaka. Sabata ndi sabata Mpingo umayenda m'moyo ndi chiphunzitso cha Khristu. Mtundu wake ndi wobiriwira, chizindikiro cha chiyembekezo ndi kukula.
about_seasonLent: Lenti ndi masiku makumi anayi a pemphero, kusala kudya ndi kupereka zachifundo kuyambira Lachitatu la Phulusa mpaka Lachinayi Lopatulika, pamene okhulupirira abwerera kwa Mulungu mwa kulapa ndi kukonzekera kukondwerera Chinsinsi cha Pasaka. Mtundu wake ndi wofiirira, ndi pinki pa Lamlungu la Laetare.
about_seasonHolyWeek: Sabata Lopatulika limayamba pa Lamlungu la Kanjedza, pamene Mpingo ukukumbukira kulowa kwa Ambuye wathu mu Yerusalemu, ndipo limatsogolera ku Masiku Atatu Opatulika a Mazunzo, Imfa ndi Kuuka kwake. Lamlungu la Kanjedza ndi lofiira; masiku a sabata ndi ofiirira.
about_seasonTriduum: Masiku Atatu Opatulika a Pasaka, kuyambira Misa ya Mgonero wa Ambuye madzulo a Lachinayi Lopatulika mpaka madzulo a Lamlungu la Pasaka, ndi pamwamba pa chaka chonse cha mapemphero: Mazunzo, Imfa ndi Kuuka kwa Ambuye.
about_seasonEaster: Nyengo ya Pasaka ndi masiku makumi asanu kuyambira Lamlungu la Pasaka mpaka Pentekoste, okondweretsedwa ngati Lamlungu limodzi lalikulu lachimwemwe mwa Ambuye wouka. Mtundu wake ndi woyera, ndi wofiira pa Pentekoste.
